scope: Each concurrency on the complete fixed 128-record corpus, with every timed repetition scored
frozen_before: full-corpus evaluation or selection of native fused RMSNorm candidates
asr_reference: minimum measured error rate of the two matched baseline frameworks at the same concurrency
speaker_reference: maximum baseline mean cosine similarity, with the same independently generated Ryan/Vivian anchor audio for every framework
speaker_cosine_units: raw cosine, not percentage points on a 0-100 scale
asr_backend: Whisper-large-v3, local pinned assets, float32 NPU, English WER and Chinese CER with retained transcripts
speaker_backend: SGLang-Omni pinned main WavLM-large speaker verifier and locally audited base/finetuned checkpoints
rationale: Fixed noninferiority margins of one percentage point ASR error and 0.02 speaker cosine; not fitted to approximate candidate outcomes. Exact PCM checks remain a separate stricter diagnostic and are not substituted for full quality evaluation.
limitations: Automatic ASR and speaker metrics do not establish subjective naturalness; retain generated audio and report duration/streaming continuity separately.
